# v0.22 Kernel-Perf Synthesizer — FINAL De-duplicated Honest List

**For:** manager. **Mode:** CPU-only inspection. **Grounding:** The named briefing `KERNEL-PERF-RULEDOUT-BRIEFING-v022.md` **does not exist** (all 4 scan angles independently confirmed this; I re-verified). The authoritative substitutes are `.agent/decisions/KERNEL-OPTIMIZATION-FINDINGS-FINAL.md` (§1 profile-truth, §4 WONTFIX, §5 deferred) + `proofs/perf/v015/{default_flip_v015,boulac_nz_optimization}.json` + `proofs/perf/compute_cycle_analysis.md`.

## 0. The decisive profile correction (binding on every ranking below)

The 4 scan angles split on the central fact. **They cannot both be right, and the authoritative artifact settles it:**

- **SETTLED TRUTH (FINDINGS-FINAL §1, 2026-06-13, marked AUTHORITATIVE/FINAL):** the shipped-default step on the canonical d01 128² case is **DEVICE-bound, GPU idle 4.2%**. Command-buffer capture removed **13,762 launches/step for ZERO wall change** across **4 independent A/B pairs** (`default_flip_v015.json`). **Therefore pure kernel-COUNT reduction is WALL-NEUTRAL in the shipped regime.** The "10-18k tiny kernels, 90% idle, latency-bound" number was a **CUPTI dropped-events undercount** from a micro-window, explicitly refuted.
- **The "latency-bound" framing** that several scan items lean on traces to `compute_cycle_analysis.md` (**2026-05-30**, on a **shared/contended GPU**, "idle 43-68%"). That document is **superseded by §1** and its own headline unroll proof **never completed its 24h gate** (OOM'd under contention).

**Consequence for this report:** I rank against the **device-bound** §1 truth. Any item whose ONLY mechanism is "cut kernel/launch count" is **down-rated to ~0 wall** regardless of how it is framed. A real win must cut **device-busy time on the dependent chain** OR cut the **VRAM arena** (to unlock larger device-efficient grids) — OR be an honest **non-lossless physics trade** that removes whole families of device work.

## 3. TOP-5 RANKED RECOMMENDATION (with the gate each needs)

Ranked by **honest expected wall/capability win on the SETTLED device-bound profile**, not by raw multiplier claims.

**#1 — B2: BouLac dense→O(nz) as default.** *Highest confidence real device-wall win available now.* Isolated **1.30x + 387 MB VRAM, machine-eps identity already proven** — the only "small" lever §6 names as a clean win. **Gate:** resolve the XLA 'Very slow compile' fusion pathology (Fable escalation already logged) → full-pipeline compile-time gate (<~120s) → tiered-identity vs frozen v0.14 manifest → 24h-coupled stability + d02 skill no-regression + re-profile confirming the ms drop. **Honest blocker: the compile pathology is the entire risk; if Fable can't crack it, this stays opt-in.**

**#2 — B3: PBL `bldt` cadence (non-lossless).** *Highest-confidence latency-real lever that cuts device-busy time, but with an honest ceiling caveat.* Reuses existing radiation held-rate plumbing (low new code). **Gate:** the cadence ladder (every 1/2/3/4/6 steps) on T2/U10/V10/PBLH RMSE vs every-step AND vs CPU-WRF-with-matching-`bldt` over a multi-day canary + conservation (no mass/energy drift) + **a measured per-step wall delta** (to confirm the post-niter-cut MYNN share is big enough to matter). Ship opt-in, explicit the user decision. **Do not promise 1.3-1.8x until measured — the post-fix MYNN device share may cap it well below that.**

**#3 — B1: fp32-operational state (separate MAJOR milestone, NOT a v0.22 add-on).** *The dominant remaining structural lever — but correctly future-scope.* It is the **single fix that unblocks both B2's compile pathology and the 1km capability story**. **Gate:** the ADR-031 acoustic-perturbation-form rewrite (multi-sprint, joint Opus+GPT — the acoustic is fp64-PINNED by construction) → full tiered-identity re-gate across ALL fields + physics oracles + conservation → 24-120h skill/stability on nest + 1km grids → VRAM-arena proof at 1km targets. **Flag clearly: this is a milestone, not a sprint.**

**#4 — S1: static-count reduction past the bitwise-safe floor (cond niter 16→12, surface `_zolri` cap).** *Cheap, real-but-small, corpus-gated.* Same proven axis as the shipped 50→16. **Gate:** extend the `cond_niter_oracle` to bound max-convergent niter across the FULL operational corpus (incl. deep-convective) for the smaller cap → tiered-identity + warmed wall A/B. **If any clips/non-convergence appear → operational-relaxed + the user sign-off. Honest: may net zero.**

**#5 — N1: past-CFL acoustic dt margin (non-lossless, explicit opt-in only).** *Highest raw multiplier in the non-lossless set, but highest numerical risk — keep the lossless CFL-safe P4 as default, this margin as opt-in.* **Gate:** CFL-ladder + finite-detector + hard rollback → (a) finiteness/stability over multi-day + steep-terrain canary, (b) full-field RMSE vs strict run in a stated band, (c) no conservation drift → the user per-case decision.

---

## 4. The one honest caveat on the rejected unroll (R1)

I reject the acoustic unroll as a **banked win**, but I will not call it fully dead, to stay honest: its only measurement (1.225x) was on the **d02 nest** under contention, whereas the device-bound §1 truth was measured on **d01 128² single-domain**. It is *conceivable* the nest regime differs. **But:** (a) it re-treads the §4 scan-unroll ruled-out, (b) it is not bit-identical, (c) its compile cost is materially adverse for the compile-constrained 9-nest and literally *caused* its own 24h-gate OOM, and (d) the win, if real, **overlaps B3/N1's mechanism**. **Verdict: do not pursue unless a clean free-GPU A/B on the *current* nest code first proves a non-trivial wall win that survives the compile-cost accounting — which I judge unlikely. It is NOT a recommended lever.**

## 5. Bottom line for the manager

The brutal truth: **on the settled device-bound profile, there is no cheap launch-count win left** — that entire class is closed (§4, 4 A/B pairs). The genuine remaining levers are exactly two structural device-wall/arena fixes (**B2 now, B1 as a milestone**), both gated on the **same XLA mixed-precision/data-dependent compile pathology**, plus one measured-but-capped non-lossless cadence lever (**B3**). Everything else is either small/corpus-gated or a deliberate fidelity trade requiring the user's sign-off. A short true list: **B2, B3, B1 — in that order — is the real v0.22+ kernel-perf frontier.**
